candidates.story_title: Koniag Advisory & Business Solutions wins $18M DOE SBIR/STTR support contract via 8(a) sole source
candidates.summary: Koniag Advisory and Business Solutions LLC, a subsidiary of Koniag Government Services (the Alaska Native Corporation for Kodiak Archipelago shareholders), was awarded a five-year $18,023,062 contract by the Department of Energy to provide programmatic support for DOE's SBIR/STTR programs. Reported June 5, 2026; set aside as an 8(a) sole-source award.
candidates.why_it_matters: ANC 8(a) status unlocked the award through a civilian agency (DOE) at a time when DOD 8(a) sole-source authority faces scrutiny, channeling federal dollars to a Kodiak-connected Native corporation.
candidates.industry_consequence: Federal services: Koniag Government Services secures an $18M, 5-year DOE revenue stream via 8(a) sole source; ANC-affiliated firms weigh civilian-agency 8(a) pipelines as a hedge before FY end Sept 2026.
candidates.validator_note: Verify $18M figure and award existence on USAspending. OrangeSlices cites award ID 89303026CTT000007 but the USAspending URL differs; confirm which resolves and the correct dollar amount and that DOE is the awarding agency.

candidates.story_title: AFA Council 30 (Alaska Airlines flight attendants) enters national AI-labor fight as Great American AI Act drops
candidates.summary: LeiLauni Scheideman, president of AFA Council 30 representing Anchorage-based Alaska Airlines flight attendants, published an ADN op-ed June 1, 2026 opposing federal preemption of state AI worker protections, citing AI monitoring of flight attendants. On June 4 the bipartisan Great American AI Act discussion draft proposed a three-year preemption of state AI laws; AFA-CWA (parent union) and AFT issued a joint statement opposing it.
candidates.why_it_matters: Alaska has no enacted AI labor law; a federal preemption would lock the legislature out of passing AI workplace guardrails for three years as Alaska Airlines deepens AI deployment.
candidates.industry_consequence: Aviation-labor: AFA Council 30 (Anchorage) faces a closing window; if GAAIA advances, Alaska loses ability to enact AI workplace-monitoring protections through ~2028.
candidates.validator_note: GAAIA preemption was covered in prior weeks; the NEW element is the AFA/aviation-labor angle. Verify Scheideman op-ed and the AFT/AFA-CWA joint statement quote verbatim. ADN url slug says 05-31 but pub date reported 06-01; confirm in-window.

candidates.story_title: NSF TechAccess AI-Ready America Round 1 LOI closes June 16 — Alaska eligible for a $3M, 3-year AI workforce hub
candidates.summary: NSF's TechAccess: AI-Ready America (NSF 26-508), a $224M initiative co-developed with DOL, funds one AI Coordination Hub per state/territory at $1M/yr for 3 years. Round 1 selects 10 hubs; mandatory LOI due June 16, 2026. Alaska is one of 56 eligible jurisdictions; University of Alaska System is an eligible lead type.
candidates.why_it_matters: A use-it-or-lose-it window: missing the June 16 LOI defers Alaska to Round 2 (Dec 15, 2026) while 10 states build hubs.
candidates.industry_consequence: Higher ed/workforce: University of Alaska System (or AWIB consortium) must decide by June 16, 2026 whether to file an LOI for a $3M, 3-year NSF AI hub.
candidates.validator_note: Solicitation posted 2026-03-25 (out of window) but June 16 LOI deadline is the live in-window action. Verify $224M, $1M/yr/3yr, June 16 LOI, 56 jurisdictions, 10 Round-1 hubs on NSF primary. Do NOT assert a confirmed Alaska filing.

candidates.story_title: First federal AI-CSAM sentencing in Alaska — Anchorage man gets ~5 years
candidates.summary: On June 3, 2026 Anthaney O'Connor was sentenced in federal court in Alaska after pleading guilty to receipt of child pornography; the case involved AI-generated CSAM and a co-offender who was a JBER airman. DOJ/USAO-AK primary press release.
candidates.why_it_matters: Federal prosecutors in Alaska are already securing sentences for AI-generated CSAM under federal law while the state's HB 47 stalled.
candidates.industry_consequence: Criminal law/defense: a concrete in-state prosecutorial record on AI-CSAM; JBER personnel link. Business consequence is thin for capital audience.
candidates.validator_note: Verify the DOJ press release resolves and the sentence length. Likely too thin on business consequence to feature; candidate for cut.

candidates.story_title: Glenfarne reveals $44.5B-$54.5B Alaska LNG cost; June 19 special-session deadline
candidates.summary: During the LNG special session Glenfarne disclosed June 3-4 the project will cost $44.5B-$54.5B; Senate Finance co-chair Stedman called it low. June 5 Glenfarne offered an in-state gas price cap. Tax bill must pass by June 19.
candidates.why_it_matters: Alaska LNG is the only large-scale gas answer to the Railbelt Cook Inlet shortage that Chugach/GVEA cite when declining large data-center loads. Governor has pitched it as the AI data-center energy backbone.
candidates.industry_consequence: Energy/AI infra: June 19 vote gates whether grid-connected Railbelt data centers ever pencil; this resets power math under every gigawatt pitch.
candidates.validator_note: Covered in prior weeks (06-03/06-04). Usable only as a one-line stakes/context beat. Verify the $44.5B-$54.5B and June 19 deadline. Confirm the cost figure was disclosed in-window.

candidates.story_title: Alaska DNR comment period on Stak Energy $500M North Slope AI data-center land lease closes June 15
candidates.summary: DNR issued a preliminary best-interest finding May 12 supporting a 50-year, 715-acre state land lease to Stak Energy for a gas-powered data center near Deadhorse. Public comment closes June 15, 2026. No disclosed investors/customers/gas agreement.
candidates.why_it_matters: June 15 comment close is an in-window action-forcing date; finalization could encumber state land at scale with no energy source secured.
candidates.industry_consequence: Oil & gas / digital infra: DNR may finalize a 50-year lease after June 15; North Slope gas producers must signal supply interest or opposition.
candidates.validator_note: Data-center frame heavily covered. Announcement pre-window; June 15 comment close is the in-window hook. Usable as a one-line supporting beat only. STRIP unverified specs (3GW, acreage) unless confirmed.
